features: Unmatched Signal Strength : Powered by self-developed silver-plated signal technology and advanced antenna protection, delivering the strongest signal among feature phones.
Extreme Temperature Endurance : Engineered for reliability in harsh conditions – operates from -40°C to 70°C, making it perfect for any environment.
Triple SIM : Stay connected on your terms with 3 SIM slots – more communication options, more freedom.
Long Battery Life with KingVoice : Enjoy 33 days of standby with a 1500mAh battery and automatic message broadcasting through the KingVoice system.

Built to Last with Rugged Style : Backed by a 13-month warranty and 111 replacement guarantee, the King Signal is built for durability and peace of mind and rugged design in Purple, Red, Army Green, and Black.
description: The itel Kingsignal is designed for unmatched connectivity with its Signal Enhancement Technology, ensuring super strong network reception even in low-signal areas. Built with a rugged and durable design, it offers long-lasting reliability. The 1500 mAh battery with a Type-C charger ensures extended power, while Anonymous Auto Call Recording keeps your conversations private. Featuring a 2” display, Triple SIM support, and KingVoice, which reads out menu options for easy navigation, the Kingsignal is a perfect blend of power, durability, and convenience. Stay connected anytime, anywhere with the itel Kingsignal – your ultimate communication companion!
